family.description: This entry represents the ubiquitin-like domain of WDR48 and its homologues. WDR48 (also known as UAF1) is a regulator of deubiquitinating complexes [[cite:PUB00092494],[cite:PUB00092495],[cite:PUB00092496]]. Bun107 is required for the Ubp9 recruitment to septa and cell tips but also for its enzymatic activity at these specific locations [[cite:PUB00057398]].
family.name: WDR48/Bun107, ubiquitin-like domain
